conclusion: Every Python and npm package now has an identifiable license. The repository license is Apache-2.0 and permits commercial use. Copyleft and source-available dependencies are listed with their obligations. This audit is not a legal opinion and does not clear the obligations for a combined binary or hosted distribution.
